# Azure SQL Developer Hub

> App templates and practical patterns for Azure SQL Database. Explore dashboards, APIs, search, and multi-tenant applications with your preferred stack. Each template includes a build prompt and validation checks rather than a prebuilt codebase. Coding-agent skills are available for guided development.

_Last updated: September 2026._

> Every page on this site has a markdown twin at the same path with `.md`. The whole site in one file is at /llms-full.txt.

## When to use this site
Use this hub when the job is one of these:
- Start a new app on Azure SQL Database: pick a template under "App templates and building blocks" and work through its prompt.
- Pick a template: each entry names its stack and what it builds. The full apps cover concurrent writes, exact money arithmetic, batch imports, and tenant isolation; the building blocks cover one task each.
- Get a database to build against: a free Azure SQL Database in the cloud, or the Azure SQL Database container on the local machine (see "Get a database running" and "Container: get started").
- Give the coding agent Azure SQL knowledge: install the Microsoft SQL skills (see "Install the agent skills" under Optional).

For Azure SQL reference documentation, pricing, and running production workloads, use https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/azure-sql/ instead.

How to work from a template:
1. Fetch the prompt's Markdown file, the `.md` link, rather than the HTML page.
2. Follow its steps in order, including its Safety section: stop and ask before dropping or truncating a table that has rows, granting permissions, or creating Azure resources.
3. Connect with Microsoft Entra. Keep passwords out of code and config.
4. Finish with the prompt's checks, its "Validation rules" or "Check your work" section, and report which pass.

- [Before you build]({{ site.url }}{{ site.baseurl }}/#faq): what you need, what it costs, whether you need the container, whether it is safe to let an agent write to your database.

- [Container FAQ]({{ site.url }}{{ site.baseurl }}/container/faq.md): what the container is for, which Azure SQL Database features it includes and leaves out, and moving to Azure.

## App templates and building blocks
Build briefs with requirements and validation checks for Azure SQL Database in the cloud. Use the prompts with a coding agent to implement and customize an app:
- [Build a task-tracking app]({{ site.url }}{{ site.baseurl }}/build/javascript-app.md): JavaScript. Build a web app that displays tasks stored in Azure SQL. Start with sample data and make it your own.
- [Build an API for your app]({{ site.url }}{{ site.baseurl }}/build/python-api.md): Python. Give your app a way to create, complete, and retrieve tasks. Build a Python API that connects to Azure SQL with Microsoft Entra, no passwords.
- [Search your content by meaning]({{ site.url }}{{ site.baseurl }}/build/rag-app.md): Python / AI. Find relevant text with vector search in Azure SQL. Build the retrieval layer for a RAG app using sample text and an embedding model you provide.
- [Create a serverless task API]({{ site.url }}{{ site.baseurl }}/build/serverless-api.md): .NET. Read and save tasks through an Azure Functions API backed by Azure SQL. Build and test the functions locally.
- [Respond to data changes]({{ site.url }}{{ site.baseurl }}/build/event-driven-app.md): .NET. Extend the serverless API with a function that reacts when tasks change in Azure SQL. Log inserts, updates, and deletes as a starting point for automation.
- [Separate each customer's data]({{ site.url }}{{ site.baseurl }}/build/multi-tenant.md): JavaScript. Extend a task app for multiple customers. Add row-level security and test that one tenant cannot read another tenant's tasks.
- [Build a team task board]({{ site.url }}{{ site.baseurl }}/build/team-board.md): Full app. Filters by project, assignee, status, priority, and overdue together, due dates from one fixed clock, and seed data that survives restarts.
- [Build an inventory reservation app]({{ site.url }}{{ site.baseurl }}/build/inventory-reservations.md): Full app. Reserve stock under concurrent orders without overselling, with idempotent retries and an audit trail that commits with each change.
- [Build a revenue reporting app]({{ site.url }}{{ site.baseurl }}/build/revenue-reporting.md): Full app. Exact money arithmetic in integer cents, partial refunds, order-date cohorts, and totals that count each sale once.
- [Build a shipment tracker]({{ site.url }}{{ site.baseurl }}/build/shipment-tracker.md): Full app. Import shipment-event batches atomically, catch duplicates and conflicts, replay safely, and order late events the same way on every run.
- [Build a multi-tenant helpdesk]({{ site.url }}{{ site.baseurl }}/build/multi-tenant-helpdesk.md): Full app. Signed identities, tenant isolation in the API and with row-level security, role checks, and safe connection reuse.

## Key facts
- Target: Azure SQL Database in the Microsoft Azure cloud. The free tier covers every prompt on this site, within its limits. Connect with Microsoft Entra; never a password in code or config.
- Authentication by driver: `mssql` (Node) uses `authentication: { type: "azure-active-directory-default" }`; `Microsoft.Data.SqlClient` (.NET) uses `Authentication=Active Directory Default`; `mssql-python` acquires a token with `azure-identity` and passes it to the driver.
- AI-native: native `VECTOR` type, `VECTOR_DISTANCE` similarity search, `AI_GENERATE_EMBEDDINGS`, `CREATE EXTERNAL MODEL`, native JSON, RegEx. Insert vectors as JSON arrays cast through `NVARCHAR(MAX)` first, or a long embedding is sent as ntext and fails with error 529.
- Event-driven: the Azure Functions SQL trigger requires Change Tracking on the database and the table. Output bindings upsert with `MERGE` and need a primary key and compatibility level 130 or higher.
- Multi-tenant: row-level security with a filter and block predicate keyed on `SESSION_CONTEXT`, set per connection with `sp_set_session_context`.
- The free tier runs on serverless compute with auto-pause; the first connection to a paused database can return error 40613 and succeeds on retry.
- Local development: the Azure SQL Database container runs the same engine offline. Public preview; pull mcr.microsoft.com/mssql/azure-sql-db-server:latest from Microsoft Container Registry, no sign-up needed. Setup and troubleshooting: {{ site.url }}{{ site.baseurl }}/container/get-started.md. What it includes and leaves out: {{ site.url }}{{ site.baseurl }}/container/faq.md. Its local-scoped prompts live at https://github.com/microsoft/azure-sql-database-container/tree/main/docs/prompts.

## Optional
- [Repository](https://github.com/microsoft/azure-sql-dev-hub), short link https://aka.ms/azuresql-hub
- [Install the agent skills](https://aka.ms/azuresql-skills): `npx skills add microsoft/microsoft-sql` (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, VS Code with GitHub Copilot); Claude Code plugin with `claude plugin marketplace add microsoft/microsoft-sql` then `claude plugin install microsoft-sql@microsoft-sql`; or `gh skill install microsoft/microsoft-sql --all --agent <claude-code|github-copilot|cursor>`.
